title: Support React and WGPU Renderers in Playgrounds
description: Apps emit only generic framework component scenes; both React and wgpu renderers provide all rendering; app-level JS/React packages removed.
summary: Removed flow-canvas component kind; extended NodeGraphScene and TextEditorScene; merged flow-canvas into generic node-graph host; generic text-editor host with Rust-provided tokens; deleted app core/js and react packages; s plugin emits node-graph; writer plugin tokenizes in Rust.
